Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8

Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.5: Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: Which words or expressions do we use to describe things, events or people? 2. How can description make our writing better?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 14.5.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination is sharpened as the learners craft descriptive essays in composition writing.

• Communication and Collaboration is enhanced as learners assist each other to correct and revise their compositions.

Values:
Patriotism is enhanced as learners read texts about their country’s participation in various sports in the Olympics.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Safety and security is enhanced as learners read passages on Olympics to acquire knowledge on how to avoid or respond to

sporting accidents.
